verdict.rationale: Porkbun publishes a REST/JSON API reference and mirrors every real path under a zero-setup `/mock` endpoint (no key, no account), plus a `pk1_sb_` sandbox for end-to-end testing. Together these give developers runnable ways to explore endpoints. However, nothing in the evidence shows an interactive in-browser reference with try-it/runnable examples, and probes found no OpenAPI/Swagger spec. missing for 10: interactive in-browser 'try it' API explorer, embedded runnable code examples in the reference, published OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on corroboration.
